new_translation_vi: Kết nối các đường ống để đảm bảo nhiên liệu trong bình dẫn đến thiết bị đánh lửa một cách trơn tru, cho phép ngọn lửa phun ra đạt được hỏa lực cần thiết để kích hoạt cảm biến.

source_en: After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to connect the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> to the remaining section. Adjust the direction of the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> by rotating them with the Levitator.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi mở khóa Utility, bạn có thể sử dụng Levitator để kết nối <color=#ffd12f>đường ống nhiên liệu</color> với phần còn lại. Điều chỉnh hướng của <color=#ffd12f>đường ống nhiên liệu</color> bằng cách xoay chúng với Levitator.

source_en:
A poor-quality spear barrel will be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full, granting the Resonator a temporary <color=#ffd12f>Immunity</color> to the surrounding Incinero Petal Pollens.
A good-quality spear barrel will not be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full. It can be used to assemble the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color>.
new_translation_vi: Một nòng giáo chất lượng kém sẽ bị phá hủy sau khi Hit Gauge đầy, mang lại cho Resonator khả năng <color=#ffd12f>Miễn nhiễm</color> tạm thời với Phấn hoa Incinero Petal xung quanh.

source_en:
Transform into the Inferno Rider and speed along the track created by the floating highways.
As you race, you can control the Inferno Rider to wield its blade to <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> obstacles in your path and <color=#ffd12f>avoid</color> road signs.
new_translation_vi: Biến hình thành Inferno Rider và tăng tốc dọc theo đường đua được tạo bởi các đường cao tốc nổi.

source_en:
To address the issue in the Dim Forest, try to eliminate the Offshoot Cores.
When the drones light up, use either <color=#ffd12f>melee or ranged</color> attacks to rotate them, directing the sound wave emitted by the central drone towards the Offshoot Core. If successful, you'll eliminate the Offshoot Core and obtain a valuable Offshoot Core sample.
new_translation_vi: Để giải quyết vấn đề trong Dim Forest, hãy thử loại bỏ các Offshoot Core.

source_en:
Sensor II
You may find some Acoustic Prints concealing special information during your exploration. When you approach them, they will display certain appearance changes. Use the Sensor to uncover hidden mechanisms or supply chests.
new_translation_vi: Sensor II

source_en:
Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook can assist Resonators in crossing over terrains. Use it in open areas to make a leap upward, or look for Grapple Points in the map for even further travels.
new_translation_vi: Grappling Hook

source_en:
[About]
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act III "What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Traces of Tides ends.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]

Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs at the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards! 

[Eligibility] 

Reach Union Level 14. 

[Event Rules] 

During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. 

Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package. Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards. 

There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About] 
In the eyes of the Ragunnesi, Avinoleum Theological Seminary represents a lost era. Those glorious days have been forgotten with time. Perhaps one day, no one will remember the origins of that expanse of shadows hanging in the sky.

An elderly hermit is writing his memoirs by the seminary ruins. He needs some images of Avinoleum...

[Eligibility] 
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act IV "The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier" and Side Quest "Scale of Past" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...
 
This system is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Acropolis Documentarian ends.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
"[<color=#c19f51>Tower of Adversity</color>]

A large underground comprehensive experimental center built before the Lament. It sank into the sea due to the terrain changes during the Lament, and only recently resurfaced. 

This research station has a depth of over ten thousand meters reaching the Moho, and there is a trend to continue to expand downwards. At the same time, there seems to be a periodic echo coming from the deep well, as if it is breathing. Therefore, the deep well has also gained the nickname of the Gate of Hell. 

Without a doubt, humans do not have the industrial capacity to build such a facility. At the bottom of the deep well, countless mysteries are waiting to be unveiled...

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Cycle</color>]

The environment of the Tower of Adversity naturally recovers in a <color=#c19f51>two-week</color> cycle, and the data and monsters will be updated after the cycle is reset. The rewards from the data will also be updated. 

[<color=#c19f51>Underground Structure</color>]

The Tower of Adversity has <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas to be explored, and each area has <color=#c19f51>4</color> depths. Only after the explorer has completed the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas at the same depth, can they proceed to explore the deeper layers. 

[<color=#c19f51>Lineup Selection</color>]

Exploration requires the formation of <color=#c19f51>3</color> teams, each to complete the exploration of <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas. The Resonators who have already fought will be locked in the exploration area and cannot participate in the exploration of other areas until the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas of the same difficulty is completed. The explorer can choose to manually unlock the Resonators, but after the unlock, the exploration points of the current area will be reset. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Rules</color>]

Explorers need to conduct multi-layer exploration in each area, each layer of exploration has a certain time limit. If the exploration is not completed within the time limit, it will be judged as a failure; if all the monsters are defeated within the time limit, it will be judged as a pass. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Degree</color>]

When the explorer is exploring the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, the exploration degree will be evaluated in real time according to the explorer's performance. After the exploration is completed, a fixed amount of exploration points will be settled; 

When the explorer is exploring the mutation layer, the exploration should be ended as soon as possible to avoid pollution. The <color=#c19f51>faster the exploration is completed</color>, the <color=#c19f51>more exploration points will be obtained at the time of settlement</color>. 

[<color=#c19f51>Residual Echo</color>]

In the research station, each area node will have a Master of Illusion. The Master of Illusion has obtained the enhancement of the Lament's Echo, and has a stronger power than the general monsters, and even has rule-like characteristics (such as enhancement effects). The explorer needs to choose the lineup carefully according to the characteristics. 

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

The deeper the exploration, the more information obtained, the more rewards. Every time a certain exploration degree is reached, rewards will be settled at the end of the cycle; when the explorer has completed the exploration of the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, rewards can be obtained in advance. 

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity, it is not possible to cultivate Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the exploration, and some system functions will also be prohibited."
new_translation_vi: "[<color=#c19f51>Tower of Adversity</color>]

[About]
Victory does not come easily. A Cube's got to sweat a little to win the race! Join the Cubes in training, complete practice rounds to earn some exciting rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
1. In "Cubie Derby: Warmup," complete tasks to earn dice. Roll the dice to move Rover Cube across the map and collect rewards along the way.
2. Land on certain pads to meet new Cubes and unlock unique Cube Bonuses.

source_en:
[About]
KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvenirs in the Second Coming of Solaris!

[Eligibility]
Complete Side Quest "Scale of Past" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...

This is a permanent event. Scale of Past will remain accessible via the special item Trace Scale after the event Memory Travelogue has ended.

source_en:
Dear Rover, every year on your birthday, we prepare a unique gift to make your day extra special. Whatever is that you wish for, we believe it will surely come true one day.
This is Solaris-3, a place made better because of you, a story written together with you. Wherever your journey leads, take our blessings with you. And on this special day, we hope you'll take a moment to pause and stay with us, even if it's just for a while.

[Set Your Date of Birth]
1. Once you've set your date of birth and reached Union Level 2, the Birthday Blessing feature will be unlocked.
2. Please note, <color=HighlightB>your date of birth cannot be changed once set</color>. Be sure to enter the correct date.

[Birthday Blessing]
1. Log in on the day of your birthday or within 7 days after to receive a unique birthday surprise.
2. If you missed the 7 days but logged in within 30 days after your birthday, the gift will still be sent to you via WavesLine. If you haven't unlocked WavesLine, the gift will be sent directly to your Backpack.
3. If features such as the "Reprise of Tides" are triggered when you log in on your birthday or within 7 days after, the Birthday Blessing will be delayed and delivered on your next login.
4. <color=HighlightB>If your birthday has passed when you finish the birthdate initial setting, you can still receive the birthday blessings and gift for the current year via WavesLine.</color>
new_translation_vi: Thân gửi Rover, mỗi năm vào ngày sinh nhật của bạn, chúng tôi đều chuẩn bị một món quà độc đáo để làm cho ngày của bạn trở nên đặc biệt hơn. Dù bạn ước điều gì, chúng tôi tin rằng một ngày nào đó nó chắc chắn sẽ thành hiện thực.

source_en:
[About]
To encourage the Pioneers to further share their Ragunna explorations, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs to the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs.
Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package; Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards.
There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
To every Rover who's walked this long road with us, thank you for being here.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
Log in during the event period to claim the rewards.
Rewards for this event will NOT be reissued via in-game mail once the event ends. Please pay close attention to the event time and claim the rewards beforehand.
new_translation_vi: Gửi đến mọi Rover đã cùng chúng tôi đi trên con đường dài này, cảm ơn bạn vì đã ở đây.

source_en:
[Watch Films]
-Encounter a variety of events during the Solaris Film Festival. Use Film Rolls to explore stories and reach different endings!
-The Somnoire is pulsing with mysterious power. Upon entering, all Resonators are stripped of their Echoes, but in their place are Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, and other unique buffs waiting to be discovered.
-Explore different team builds and combinations for diverse combat experiences.
-This event features a new Bond system. Bond can now be formed between Resonators, granting various combat buffs and powerful Synergy Burst as its level increases.
(Rover's attribute is locked the moment you enter the Festival.)

[Dream Archive]
Track Metaphors and Events you've collected during the films and claim corresponding rewards.

[Watchlist]
Complete corresponding tasks during the opening period of the Watchlist to earn rewards. Once the period ends, the Watchlist will no longer be accessible.

[Dream Pawnshop]
Earn "Tradable Dreams" by watching films and exchanging them for various rewards.

[Film Theory]
Earn "Observer's Dice" from exploring the Solaris Film Festival. Use them in [Film Theory] to activate special bonuses that empower your Resonators.

[Film Stills]
Each story features one or more endings. Collecting different endings to unlock milestone rewards.
new_translation_vi: [Xem Phim]

source_en:
[Mission Release]

The Pioneer Association releases several missions daily. Rewards can be obtained through the Pioneer Association after the completion of the missions.



[Mission Preference]

1. Missions may come from different countries and different forces. The mission taker can modify the mission preference independently, but cannot accept missions from countries and forces that have not yet been contacted.

2. After modifying the mission preference to "Random Country", missions from any forces from any country can be obtained.

3. After modifying the mission preference to "Random Force", missions from any forces from the selected country can be obtained.

4. The modification of the mission preference will take effect the next day.
new_translation_vi: [Phát hành Nhiệm vụ]

source_en:
Trial Resonators include Featured Trial Resonators and Permanent Trial Resonators. Featured Trial Resonators change periodically.
You can recruit any available Trial Resonators during challenges (based on the list of available Resonators at the time of challenge start).
new_translation_vi: Trial Resonator bao gồm Featured Trial Resonator và Permanent Trial Resonator. Featured Trial Resonator thay đổi định kỳ.

source_en:
[About]
The clouds above bear witness to echoing battle cries, the wild lands remember the footsteps of warriors, and rushing currents carry the fiery passion of the brave. Here, every corner holds shining tributes to a glorious history. The towering cities, spires, and mighty walls forged by the people of the Septimont stand as enduring proof of their strength and resolve.

At the harbor, you meet a quarreling father and daughter. This unexpected encounter sets you on a journey to uncover the rich history of Septimont...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act V "Shadow of Glory" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...

This system is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Uncovering Past Heroes event ends.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]

The Lollo Campaign is facing an unexpected crisis! To save Maji's career, and to keep those convenient services running, help him verify the reliability of Lollo Campaign!

Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics. Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps. 

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

[<color=#c19f51>Activity Task</color>]
Complete Activity Task to claim rewards. Activity Task resets at 4:00 everyday.

[<color=#c19f51>Activity Reward</color>]
Earn Activity Points to claim corresponding rewards.
Activity Points and Stage Rewards reset at 4:00 everyday. Unclaimed rewards will be cleared. Please note the reset time and claim your rewards.

source_en:
[Event Overview]
A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called "Peaks of Prestige." It's said that countless challengers have set out on a journey to claim the legendary title of "Apex Duelist."
"Countless Echoes. Limitless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and reach Capitoline Hilltop in Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."

[Event Rules]
- You can summon special Echoes from "Peaks of Prestige" to build your own deck and engage in thrilling duels across Septimont. Claim honor and fame while you rise to become the very first Apex Duelist of Septimont!
- In the event, you need to defeat five Lords of Prestige and one Conqueror of Prestige to complete the challenges and earn the rewards. After claiming the title of Legendary Duelist, you'll unlock Endless Challenge and face mysterious duelists.
- This event cannot be completed in Co-op mode. Please exit Co-op to progress through event quests.
- During the Limited-Time Rewards period, you can claim generous rewards by completing tasks or by spending Token of Radiance earned through duels in the Radiant Selection shop. Exclusive rewards include the Echo Aspect "Moment of Triumph" and more!
- Once the period ends, Limited-Time Rewards will no longer be available, but you can continue participating in the event to earn Standard Rewards.
new_translation_vi: [Tổng quan Sự kiện]

source_en:
1. Event Tasks are divided into four parts. Complete them to gain Tokens of Radiance, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Radiant Selection.
2. The Radiant Selection shop will only be available for a limited time, and Tokens of Radiance will be cleared when it closes, so please pay attention to the remaining time.

source_en:
1. Progressing through the event will unlock multiple Tactic sets corresponding to different Resonators. These Resonator Tactics provide powerful effects during duels.
2. Each Resonator has one Active Tactic and one Passive Tactic.
Active Tactics require Energy to use, while Passive Tactics activate automatically when their conditions are met.
3. You'll also receive rewards when unlocking each Resonator's Tactics set for the first time.

source_en:
[Medal of Prestige]
- Earn Medals of Prestige by defeating Lords of Glory or increasing your Duelist Level. Collect Medals of Prestige to claim various rewards.
- Medals of Prestige provide set bonuses. Collecting a certain number of Medals of the same type will activate special buffs.

[Echo Collection]
- Collect different Echoes to unlock rewards. You can view detailed info about each Echo, and use Glory Points to unlock those you haven't obtained yet.
- During the event, you can also upgrade the appearance of your Echoes.

source_en:
[About]
The Fabricatorium of the Deep has stirred beneath the waves, its unrest quietly noted by the nobles and the Order. To prevent further disruption to the lives of the people of Ragunna and to avoid unnecessary panic, both sides held a rare private meeting. In an unprecedented move, they reached a consensus: a full re-survey of the facility must be conducted to inform joint discussions on the fate of the Fabricatorium and the Common Echoes it holds.

As the only one to return from that place unscathed, you are undoubtedly the best person to lead this expedition.

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act VII "Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Deep Sea Survey ends.

source_en:
[About]
On the crimson earth of the Sanguis Plateaus, the scorched front of Septimont's war against the Dark Tide, generations of Gladiators have carved their legends into the land with their blood. Now, it's time to walk their path, fight beside the heroes' spirits, and forge an immortal name in the fires of glory.

[Eligibility]
Complete the first hunt in the Main Quest "By Sun's Burning Hand."

[Event Rules]
- The event is divided into four phases, each unlocking as you progress through the Main Quest. Complete event tasks to earn generous rewards.
- If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
- Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode, and Quest Tracking is not available while in certain areas of the quest.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
1. In Deathtrap Mode, you can choose a Tactic after surviving each wave of attacks. 
2. Some waves may even reward multiple Tactics.
3. At the end of certain waves, KU-Money's Shop opens, allowing you to purchase Tactics using Sim Credits.
4. Tactics come in four rarities: Green, Blue, Purple, and Gold, with higher rarities offering stronger effects.
5. They're also grouped into Tactic Sets based on their type. You start with access to Green and Blue Tactics from each set. As you collect more Tactics from a set, the Purple and Gold ones of that set become available.
new_translation_vi: 1. Trong chế độ Deathtrap, bạn có thể chọn một Tactic sau khi sống sót qua mỗi đợt tấn công.

source_en:
[About]
The agents of the Black Shores have long been the first to respond in times of crisis. To lower the risks they face in fighting the TDs, the Black Shores has developed specialized combat devices designed to counter the threat. Valentina is now leading simulation tests of the devices, and she's counting on your assistance to push the tests forward.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue to unlock.

[Event Rules]
1. In this event, you will deploy Combat Machines to defend the Energy Matrix against simulated TD Outbreaks.
2. The simulated Tacet Discords attack in waves. You will have time to strategically place various types of Combat Machines before each wave begins.
3. Build your lineup wisely to counter different types of Tacet Discord.
4. Progress through the stages to unlock the "Deathtrap Mode,"  where new Tactics provide powerful battle boosts.
5. During the Limited-Time Rewards period, complete tasks to earn "TD Slayer" Coupons. Collect enough to unlock Phantom: Fallacy of No Return.
6. Any unclaimed rewards will be automatically sent to you via Mail the next time you log in within 30 days after the Limited-Time Rewards period expires.
7. Limited-time rewards cannot be claimed once the reward window ends, but you can continue playing to earn permanent rewards.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
Stages in this event support progress saving when you quit mid-challenge. Upon re-entering the stage, you can choose to continue from your last save or start over.

Notices:
1. The saved progress includes: wave progress, deployed Combat Machines, and unlocked Overwatch Protocols and Combat Machine upgrades when you first started the stage. In the Deathtrap Mode, it will also include any Tactics or items obtained.
2. Progress is automatically saved after each wave ends and after selecting Tactics in Deathtrap Mode.
3. All progress saved when quitting in mid-challenge will be erased after the game updates to a new version. Please keep the version update times in mind.
new_translation_vi: Các màn chơi trong sự kiện này hỗ trợ lưu tiến trình khi bạn thoát giữa chừng. Khi vào lại màn chơi, bạn có thể chọn tiếp tục từ lần lưu cuối cùng hoặc bắt đầu lại.

source_en:
[About]
The Huaxu Academy has recently made a breakthrough in Utility tech. Researcher Lanyan now requests your help testing a new tool near the Academy.

[Event Rules]
1. Assist Lanyan in testing the Flight Utility to earn Astrites, upgrade materials, and other rewards.
2. Rovers who have not yet unlocked Flight can gain access to the ability by participating in the event. Those who have already unlocked Flight can immediately use it in Jinzhou.
3. The event will remain available until completed, and will automatically close some time after completion.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[Introduction]
Built on the principles of ancient sonar technology, this detector locates special collectibles by scanning their specific frequencies within an area.
 
[Instructions]
1. Sonar Circuits are required to use the Casket Sonar. Sonar Circuits can be synthesized at the Synthesizer, and the Synthesize recipe for Sonar Circuits is unlocked by increasing your Pioneer Association Level.
2. Once special collectibles are located, the Casket Sonar will stay activated. It will deactivate once all identified items are collected. You can locate up to 5 collectibles at once.
3. The Casket Sonar can only be used in areas where a Use Permit has been obtained. Special collectibles in unauthorized regions cannot be located.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[Introduction]
The Lootmapper identifies specific frequencies to quickly locate nearby undiscovered Supply Chests. It is an indispensable tool to facilitate exploration in the wilds.

[Instructions]
1. Place a Lootmapper to scan for nearby, undiscovered Supply Chests within its range. 
2. You can only place 3 Lootmappers at once. If you exceed the limit, the first one will be taken back automatically. You may also manually retrieve any Lootmapper you have placed.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
Beneath the azure sky, amidst towering buildings and bustling streets, powdery snow swirls, while colorful koi streamers drift in the wind. People stroll through the city markets, unaware that they are but whispers of waves—fleeting illusions in a vanishing dream.
A stranger arrives at the cafe and asks for your help to retrieve the memories hidden within the Irideglow...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chronorift Metropolis Chapter II - Segue "Flowing Starlight in the Iris" and Side Quest "Scale of Past" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Whispers of the Waves ends.

source_en:
[About]
Shui is actively seeking new members for the prestigious Overdash Club. If you're interested, go have a friendly conversation with him to learn more.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest: Chapter 1 Act 2.

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to challenge several Tactical Hologram: Overdash Tracks. You can fast-travel to any available track to start the challenge.
2. After the challenge starts, reach the finish line within the specified time and try to collect as many Hologram Tokens as possible. Upon reaching the finish line, challenge points will be calculated based on the number of Hologram Tokens collected. Reach higher points for better rewards!
3. There are various modules available in Tactical Hologram: Overdash. You can utilize them strategically to reach the finish line faster, but be sure to mind the traps at the same time.

[Echo Collection]
Unlock new Echoes and enhance the quality of existing ones to get more Echo Collection progress and gain Data Bank EXP.

[Sonata Effect]
Echoes may have different attributes due to data differences. All known possible random results are listed in the Echo Gallery. Click to go to the Sonata Collections to view the specific effects.

source_en:
[About]
Each companion has her own preferences for drinks. Try to find out their favorite ingredients and flavors through conversation, then create the drink they like best.
 
[Instructions]
Making a drink consists of four steps:
1. Select the first drink base.
2. Select the second drink base.
3. Select add-ins.
4. Select a topping.
The flavor of a drink depends on the combination of bases and add-ins you use, which also determines its type.
Your companion will rate each drink based on how well its flavor matches the order and whether its type is her personal preference. To receive the first-clear rewards, you must earn a rating of "Satisfied" or higher.
Earn a "Very Satisfied" rating to unlock bonus dialogue.

source_en:
[About]
In Party Decor, you can collect a variety of decorations and use them to adorn the venue however you like.
[Areas]
The party venue is divided into multiple areas. Each area can be decorated freely and independently.
[Vibe Gauge]
Each decoration provides certain points of Vibe Gauge. Increasing the Vibe Gauge raises an area's Vibe Level, which unlocks new furnishings and rewards once specific requirements are met.

Complete event activities and limited-time tasks to earn Lollo Vouchers and other rewards.
Collect Lollo Vouchers to reach milestone stages and claim corresponding rewards.

source_en:
[Gifts of Thawing Frost]
1. After the event starts, you can claim the check-in rewards by logging in to the game after 04:00 server time every day.
2. This event is a permanent event. After you claim all rewards, this event will automatically conclude.
new_translation_vi: [Gifts of Thawing Frost]

source_en:
All new content Phantasm Amass is now available!

[About]
As the Somnoire's expansion comes to a halt, the domain beyond the gateway appears far from restoring its former peace. New chaos emerges from abnormal dreams trapped in a spiral of fallacy. Hearing the whispers from your subconscious, you find yourself standing before that very gateway once again...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "When the Night Knocks" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Only certain available Resonators are available in the Depths of Illusive Realm challenges.
The Illusive Realm harbors a special power that nullifies the Resonators' Echo stats. However, exclusive Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, Tokens, and special Resonator enhancements await those who explore.
Experiment with party lineups and builds for different combat experiences.
Explore the Illusive Realm for great rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the dream mass found at the deepest parts of the realm. Use Reward Attempts to collect its rewards.
Remnant Crystal Reward Attempts reset every Monday at 04:00 A.M. server time.
The Remnant Crystal grants equal rewards across all Phantasm Amass difficulties.

[Awakening Journey]
1. After the event starts, you can claim rich rewards by reaching specified Union Levels.
2. This event is a permanent event. After you claim all rewards, this event will automatically conclude.
new_translation_vi: [Awakening Journey]

source_en:
[Voyage's Beginning]
See this page for tips on how to unlock various rewards as you explore the world of Wuthering Waves.
This permanent event automatically ends once all rewards have been claimed.
new_translation_vi: [Voyage's Beginning]

source_en:
[Standard Merge]
You can merge or Batch Merge 5 unupgraded Echoes into 1 random new Echo in the Terminal.
You cannot select equipped and locked Echoes as Merge Materials.

[Targeted Merge]
This feature unlocks at Data Bank Lv. 15.
You can merge 5 unupgraded 5-Star Echoes into a random new Echo of the Sonata Effect of your choice.
You cannot select equipped and locked Echoes as Merge Materials.
*If a selected Sonata Effect currently only has Cost-1 or Cost-3 Echoes unlocked, Targeted Merge may still produce an Echo of a locked Cost type. In this case, the Echo produced will be of 3-Star rarity and will unlock the corresponding Echo Collection entry. Afterward, you may obtain Echoes of the newly unlocked Cost type. The highest Rarity of the Echoes obtained will depend on the current Data Bank level.

[New Echoes]
The Rarity of the Echo produced depends on your Data Bank level and is irrelevant to the Rarity of merged Echoes. Upgrade your Data Bank to get Echoes of higher Rarity from Data Merge.
Data Merge only produces Echoes already unlocked.

[Extra Yield]
Standard Merge sometimes produce extra Echoes in addition to the base yield.
Merge Echoes of higher Rarity and Cost for a higher chance to yield extra Echoes.
*Targeted Merge does not produce extra Echoes.

[Auto Select]
Auto Select lets you quickly select available Echoes in the order displayed. You can change the sort and filter settings to change which Echoes are displayed and selected first.

source_en:
1. You can spend Preparation Credits and Funds to fulfill people's Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. Each Wish has its own resource cost.
2. Fulfilling Wishes will earn you Funds and Wish Tags. Setting new records will boost Popularity.

new_translation_vi: 1. Bạn có thể tiêu tốn Preparation Credits và Funds để thực hiện Điều ước của mọi người trong <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. Mỗi Điều ước đều có chi phí tài nguyên riêng.

source_en:
There is a preferred Companion Stat for each Wish. Selecting your Companions accordingly will earn you a higher score.
To boost your Companions' stats, interact with them on the Companions page.
new_translation_vi: Mỗi Điều ước đều có một chỉ số Companion ưu tiên. Chọn Companion phù hợp sẽ giúp bạn đạt điểm số cao hơn.

source_en:

Scoring Rules: Scores fluctuate each round, as your Companions can't always perform at their absolute best. Nevertheless, Companions with higher stats have the potential to earn higher scores.
new_translation_vi: Đang chuẩn bị: Các Companion của bạn sẽ hành động theo lượt, kiếm điểm dựa trên chỉ số của họ.

source_en:
1. Companions can help you fulfill Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>.
2. They have three stats: Knowledge, Action, and Teamwork. Higher stats and better matches with the Wish's recommended stat lead to higher Wish Ratings.

new_translation_vi: 1. Companion có thể giúp bạn thực hiện Điều ước trong <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>.

source_en:
1. You can interact with Companions to boost their stats and Bond Level.
2. Each Interaction has its own cost of Wish Tags. A higher cost results in greater enhancements.
3. Complete Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> to earn Wish Tags.

source_en:
1. The fishers of the Riccioli Islands follow a strict tradition of working from sunrise to sunset, believing the night belongs to Cetus the Tidebreaker, who guides lost souls back home.

2. While sailing in certain waters around the Riccioli Islands at night, Rachel's Threat Level will rise. Once it reaches a critical point, Ghost Medusas will emerge and attack. Stay alert and avoid their strikes!

3. The riskier the waters, the greater the rewards. Fish caught in areas where Ghost Medusas appear tend to be of higher quality.

4. Some special species only appear at night. Check the Index for details.

5. Night on the Riccioli Islands spans from 19:00 to 5:00.
new_translation_vi: 1. Ngư dân tại quần đảo Riccioli tuân theo truyền thống nghiêm ngặt là làm việc từ lúc bình minh đến hoàng hôn, vì họ tin rằng màn đêm thuộc về Cetus, Tidebreaker, người dẫn lối cho những linh hồn lạc lối trở về nhà.

Complete the Lollo Campaigns proposed by Maji, the administrator of Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.

source_en:
Move the timeline to the <color=#ffd12f>right</color> to <color=#ffd12f>fast forward</color> time in its effective range.
Move the timeline to the <color=#ffd12f>left</color> to <color=#ffd12f>rewind</color> time in its effective range.
After finishing your adjustments, the objects affected by the Chronosorter will maintain the state they were in after the most recent timeline adjustment.
new_translation_vi: Di chuyển dòng thời gian sang <color=#ffd12f>phải</color> để <color=#ffd12f>tua nhanh</color> thời gian trong phạm vi hiệu quả của nó.

source_en:
Flare Crests typically come in sets and are used to seal the entrance of a ruin or other devices.
Each <color=#ffd12f>Flare Crest</color> corresponds to one <color=#ffd12f>Flare Stone</color>. Flare Crests can be extinguished by approaching and activating the corresponding Flare Stones.
After all Flare Crests of a set have been extinguished, the seal will be lifted.
new_translation_vi: Flare Crest thường đi theo bộ và được sử dụng để niêm phong lối vào của một tàn tích hoặc các thiết bị khác.

source_en: Transform into Clang Bang, <color=#ffd12f>jump</color> and then launch a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> to break through the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Caps</color>.
new_translation_vi: Biến hình thành Clang Bang, <color=#ffd12f>nhảy</color> và sau đó tung ra một đòn <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> để phá vỡ các <color=#ffd12f>Ice Caps</color>.

source_en:

Ski: Earn <color=#ffd12f>points</color> as you ski and reach the finish line within the specified time. Aim for higher points to receive better rewards!
new_translation_vi: Sau khi kích hoạt Tactical Hologram: Ski, hãy ném Grapple vào <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Point</color> phía trước để bắt đầu trượt tuyết.

source_en:
While skiing, move left and right to pass through the <color=#ffd12f>Acceleration Rings</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Point Rings</color>.
Passing through an Acceleration Ring will boost your skiing speed for a limited time.
new_translation_vi: Trong khi trượt tuyết, hãy di chuyển sang trái và phải để đi qua các <color=#ffd12f>Acceleration Rings</color> và <color=#ffd12f>Point Rings</color>.

source_en:
A special creature that huddles up and hides underground to protect itself when approached or attacked head-on.
Attack the <color=#ffd12f>weak point on Frostbugs' backs</color> <color=#ffd12f>from a distance</color> to defeat them.
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật đặc biệt cuộn tròn và trốn dưới lòng đất để tự bảo vệ mình khi bị tiếp cận hoặc tấn công trực diện.

source_en:
The last step of the Rite of Offering can only be completed after the Loong's Pearl is placed on the rite platform.
It is necessary to stand in the position in the light and <color=#ffd12f>change the viewing angle</color> to align the <color=#ffd12f>Loong's Pearl</color> on the rite platform with the <color=#ffd12f>mouth</color> of the dragon-shaped peak of Mt. Firmament in the distance.
new_translation_vi: Bước cuối cùng của Rite of Offering chỉ có thể được hoàn thành sau khi Pearl của Loong được đặt trên bệ nghi lễ.

source_en:

source_en: Observe the <color=#ffd12f>pattern of the ice cubes</color> and sit in the <color=#ffd12f>right spot</color> as the Clang Bang and <color=#ffd12f>face the right direction</color>.

1. When you complete the challenge, you may spend 60 Waveplates to claim the reward.
2. Each Tacet Field drops specific sets of Echoes as well as Echo Tuners and Echo Sealed Tubes.
new_translation_vi: 1. Khi hoàn thành thử thách, bạn có thể tiêu tốn 60 Waveplate để nhận phần thưởng.

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
Once the event is available, log in to the game daily at 04:00 server time to claim your login rewards.
After the event concludes, any unclaimed login rewards will be sent via mail if you log in to the game within 30 days afterward.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện tham gia]

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Complete Afterstory "The Flaming Red from Tomorrow" to unlock.

[About]
Platya, a Black Shores Bloom Bearer, has come to Startorch Academy chasing rumors of a Ghost Miko—whispers that seem to echo the legend of the "Lady Miko" of her distant homeland. Intrigued, you join her search.

[Rules]
You will receive a quest as soon as the event begins. A new quest will unlock daily for a total of seven days.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện tham gia]

source_en:
[About]
The 2nd Anniversary of Second Coming of Solaris is officially a go! This year, the event is powered by the four-way partnership of the Spacetrek Collective, Startorch Academy, Lollo Logistics, and the Pioneer Association. Dive into the celebration and claim your bounty of rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
- During the event, visit the event page to take part in various anniversary activities, including: Gifts of Grand Celebration, Star Bouncing, Lollo Express: Promise Delivered, and Cubie Derby: Championship. Earn 2nd Anniversary Coins through them to unlock various rewards.
- Rewards come from two progress tracks: Individual Progress and Server Progress. Individual Progress rewards are based on the number of coins you personally earn during the event. Server Progress rewards are based on the server's total coin count.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
For the couriers of Lollo Logistics, no hardship is too great, no obstacle too steep. Their resolve to deliver never wavers. As the collab season between Second Coming of Solaris and Lollo Logistics takes flight, their most demanding rush has begun...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
- During the event, complete event tasks to earn delivery rewards.
- Complete all pre-existing delivery tasks to unlock follow-up tasks and rewards.
- Packages are delivered in 3 separate batches.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
In the Endless Galaxy Track, challenge yourself with increasingly difficult stages.
1. Clear a stage to unlock the next.
2. Complete all stage goals to have your lineup and clear time recorded in Ranking.
3. Your record will be updated whenever you finish all goals on a higher stage or beat your time on a stage you've already cleared.
4. Your record will be cleared after 90 days without logging in to the game.
new_translation_vi: Trong Endless Galaxy Track, hãy thử thách bản thân với các màn chơi ngày càng khó.

source_en:
[About]
Arno, a special agent of the Black Shores, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on the Lament with the promise of generous rewards. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Act VII "Thaw of Eons."

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any unlocked challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. Once all existing Datasets are collected, new Datasets will appear. The more Datasets you collect, the better the rewards.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
1. Deliver KU-Cass Cartridges to upgrade the Data Hub.
2. Reaching a new level grants level rewards and unlocks a new Outlier: Tacet Discord.
3. Defeat Outlier: Tacet Discords for the first time to get rich rewards.
new_translation_vi: 1. Giao KU-Cass Cartridge để nâng cấp Data Hub.

source_en:
[About]
Beneath the starry sky, the Black Shores keeps its endless vigil, calculating the arrival of the Lament.
But fear not the unknown—we are born of the stars.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at the Black Shores in the main quest "To the Shore's End."

[Event Rules]
The event has three phases, each unlocking as you progress through the main quests.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available in certain game scenes.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[Mail Types]
There are two types of mail: Starred Mail and Other Mail.
Starred Mail stays pinned at the top of your mailbox and does not expire. It will not be deleted when you select "Delete Read Mails."
Other Mail has an expiration date and will be automatically deleted when it expires.

[Mail Capacity]
The mailbox can store a maximum of 99 mails.
Once the limit is reached, the oldest mails without attachments or with claimed attachments will be automatically deleted.
Make sure to claim your attachments promptly to avoid any loss from expiration and deletion.
new_translation_vi: [Các loại thư]

source_en:
[About]
Maji, the administrator of Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, decides to relaunch the Lollo Campaign. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.
Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.
There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
Outlier: Tacet Discord cannot be attacked initially. You need to upgrade your Data Hub level to unlock it. Deliver <color=#ffd12f>KU-Cass Cartridges</color> to KU-Cass to upgrade your Data Hub.
Defeat Outlier: Tacet Discord for the first time to claim rich rewards.
new_translation_vi: Outlier: Tacet Discord không thể bị tấn công ngay từ đầu. Bạn cần nâng cấp cấp độ Data Hub của mình để mở khóa nó. Giao <color=#ffd12f>KU-Cass Cartridge</color> cho KU-Cass để nâng cấp Data Hub.

source_en: While in Stellar Matrices, KU-Key's abilities are enhanced by the presence of the Shorekeeper, allowing it to open both yellow and blue portals simultaneously. KU-Key can also switch the type of energy pulses it fires, but only one portal of each color can be active at a time.
new_translation_vi: Khi ở trong Stellar Matrices, khả năng của KU-Key được tăng cường nhờ sự hiện diện của the Shorekeeper, cho phép nó mở cả cổng màu vàng và màu xanh cùng lúc. KU-Key cũng có thể chuyển đổi loại xung năng lượng mà nó bắn ra, nhưng mỗi lần chỉ có thể kích hoạt một cổng cho mỗi màu.

source_en: Glide across the sea and collect the scattered Aetherfins to guide them back home! Touch the <color=#ffd12f>blue rings</color> periodically to prevent your energy from running out.
new_translation_vi: Lướt trên biển và thu thập các Aetherfin rải rác để dẫn chúng trở về nhà! Chạm vào các <color=#ffd12f>vòng tròn màu xanh</color> định kỳ để ngăn năng lượng của bạn cạn kiệt.

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
After the event ends, any unclaimed sign-in rewards you earned will be reissued via in-game mail within 30 days upon your next login.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện tham gia]

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
After the event ends, any unclaimed sign-in rewards you earned will be reissued via in-game mail within 30 days upon your next login.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện tham gia]

source_en:
Transform into <color=#ffd12f>Gulpuff</color> to take on the challenge and reach the finish line within the specified time.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Dash</color> button to speed up the Gulpuff. Use the <color=#ffd12f>Jump</color> button to make the Gulpuff jump.
new_translation_vi: Biến hình thành <color=#ffd12f>Gulpuff</color> để tham gia thử thách và về đích trong thời gian quy định.

source_en: For <color=#ffd12f>short signals</color>, tap the button briefly. For <color=#ffd12f>long signals</color>, hold the button and release it according to the signal length.
new_translation_vi: Đối với <color=#ffd12f>tín hiệu ngắn</color>, hãy nhấn nút nhanh. Đối với <color=#ffd12f>tín hiệu dài</color>, hãy nhấn giữ nút và thả ra theo độ dài của tín hiệu.

source_en:
[About]
Complete the Pioneer Project tasks to earn awesome rewards.

[Event Rules]
The event consists of four phases. Complete the tests to claim great rewards.
After the official update, rewards claimed in the Pioneer Project will be sent to your account on the live server within 14 business days.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
Log in to the KURO APP and claim exclusive rewards.
You will not be able to access the reward page via the "KURO APP" button in game once you've claimed the rewards.
new_translation_vi: Đăng nhập vào KURO APP và nhận phần thưởng độc quyền.

source_en:
Link your account to your email to claim rewards. You will not be able to access the reward page once you've claimed your rewards.
Each email can only be linked to one game account.
new_translation_vi: Liên kết tài khoản của bạn với email để nhận phần thưởng. Bạn sẽ không thể truy cập trang phần thưởng sau khi đã nhận phần thưởng.

source_en:
[About]
Events with the "Permanent" tag offer limited-time rewards when they first launch in a new version update. After this initial claiming period ends, the event remains available permanently, but without the limited-time rewards. 
Any progress you've made in these events will be retained once they're moved to the "Permanent" tab.

[Eligibility]
You can participate in these events as soon as you meet the specified eligibility criteria.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
Join the strange white cat in rescuing your Resonator companions from their Dreamscapes. Together, you will delve deep into the Somnoire to uncover the truth behind the nightmares.
Each of the 6 Dreamscapes offers unique rewards upon completion.
new_translation_vi: Tham gia cùng chú mèo trắng kỳ lạ để giải cứu những người bạn Resonator của bạn khỏi Dreamscape của họ. Cùng nhau, bạn sẽ đi sâu vào Somnoire để khám phá sự thật đằng sau những cơn ác mộng.

source_en:
Complete Rift Runner, Nightmare Revisits, and the quest "When the Night Knocks" to earn Dream Shards.
Collect the required quantities of Dream Shards to unlock the corresponding milestone rewards.
Dream Shards are obtainable at any time by participating in the event.
new_translation_vi: Hoàn thành Rift Runner, Nightmare Revisits và nhiệm vụ "When the Night Knocks" để kiếm Dream Shard.

source_en: Complete the Limited-Time Rewards objectives to earn exclusive rewards, including the Featured 4-Star Weapon "Somnoire Anchor" and Featured Weapon Projection "Projection: Somnoire Anchor."
new_translation_vi: Hoàn thành các mục tiêu Limited-Time Rewards để nhận phần thưởng độc quyền, bao gồm Vũ khí 4 sao nổi bật "Somnoire Anchor" và Weapon Projection nổi bật "Projection: Somnoire Anchor."

source_en: In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. Collect enough Crests to earn hefty rewards.
new_translation_vi: Trong Tower of Adversity, kỹ năng của bạn sẽ được thử thách. Hoàn thành các mục tiêu thử thách cụ thể để kiếm Crest. Thu thập đủ Crest để nhận những phần thưởng hậu hĩnh.

source_en: The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: <color=#c19f51>Stable Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Experiment Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Hazard Zone</color>, and <color=#c19f51>Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing all challenges in a Zone unlocks the next Zone.
new_translation_vi: Tower of Adversity có bốn Khu vực: <color=#c19f51>Stable Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Experiment Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Hazard Zone</color> và <color=#c19f51>Overdrive Zone.</color> Mỗi Khu vực chứa từ một đến ba Tòa tháp và mỗi Tòa tháp có nhiều Tầng, mỗi tầng đại diện cho một thử thách độc đáo. Tiến triển qua các thử thách để mở khóa các Tòa tháp và Khu vực mới. Vượt qua tất cả các thử thách trong một Khu vực sẽ mở khóa Khu vực tiếp theo.

source_en: Complete the challenges and meet their challenge goals to obtain Crests. Collect a certain number of Crests to get various rewards, including Astrites and Hazard Records. Hazard Records can be exchanged for Phantom Echoes, Premium Tuners, and more at the Adversity Exchange.
new_translation_vi: Hoàn thành các thử thách và đáp ứng các mục tiêu thử thách của chúng để nhận Crest. Thu thập một số lượng Crest nhất định để nhận nhiều phần thưởng khác nhau, bao gồm Astrite và Hazard Record. Hazard Record có thể được đổi lấy Phantom Echo, Premium Tuner và nhiều vật phẩm khác tại Adversity Exchange.

source_en:
[About]
The Fisalia family's heir seems to have a request.
In Thessaleo Fells, a mysterious Terminal is flickering with ominous light. What secrets of the past might it hold?

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 27.

[Trial Store]
Complete the Trial Challenges to earn Astrites and [Trial Coin], which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards in the [Trial Store].

[Tactical Hologram: Phantom Pain] is a permanent activity that can be experienced at any time and will continue to be updated in future versions. Please stay tuned.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
A remnant creature with an intense fixation on music. <color=#ffd12f>When struck</color>, it drops the Melody Box it has collected.
Deliver the Melody Box to Aria Mummer to add the corresponding track to your collection list.
new_translation_vi: Một sinh vật tàn dư với sự ám ảnh mãnh liệt về âm nhạc. <color=#ffd12f>Khi bị tấn công</color>, nó sẽ đánh rơi Melody Box mà nó đã thu thập được.

source_en: Visit the Aria Mummer to access the Archive of Melodies feature. Select a track in an album to play. You may set a selected track as the background music around Aria Mummer by enabling <color=#ffd12f>Set As Background Music</color>.
new_translation_vi: Ghé thăm Aria Mummer để truy cập tính năng Archive of Melodies. Chọn một bản nhạc trong album để phát. Bạn có thể đặt một bản nhạc đã chọn làm nhạc nền xung quanh Aria Mummer bằng cách bật <color=#ffd12f>Set As Background Music</color>.

source_en:
Across Rinascita, you may stumble upon these fragile containers scattered around. Shatter them to uncover hidden treasures within.

Keep a close eye on those bearing the Montelli family crest, as they contain Monnaies—an old currency that can be redeemed for rewards at Averardo Bank.
new_translation_vi: Trên khắp Rinascita, bạn có thể tình cờ bắt gặp những chiếc thùng mỏng manh này nằm rải rác. Hãy đập vỡ chúng để khám

source_en: <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
new_translation_vi: <color=#ffd12f>Đánh bại</color> các <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discord</color> gần đó để đảm bảo kích hoạt thành công <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Hoàn thành thử thách để nhận phần thưởng.

source_en:
The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past.
Use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Sonance Caskets in Ragunna. The Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost are collecting them—perhaps a visit will reveal more.
new_translation_vi: Sản phẩm của một Sonoro Sphere bị sụp đổ, được tìm thấy trên khắp thế giới. Nó ghi lại những ký ức không bị bóp méo về quá khứ.

source_en: A village of Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost. The villagers are gathering Sonance Caskets throughout Ragunna to unlock the Sonoro Sphere within a morph painting.
new_translation_vi: Một ngôi làng của các Echo Plushie trong Garden of the Lost. Dân làng đang thu thập Sonance Casket trên khắp Ragunna để mở khóa Sonoro Sphere bên trong một bức tranh biến hình.

source_en:
While steering a Gondola, you can use Waterfall Surge to swim up a waterfall.
<color=#ffd12f>(Please note that this function can only be used in safe waters. Protect your Gondolas, and protect yourselves.)</color>
new_translation_vi: Trong khi lái Gondola, bạn có thể sử dụng Waterfall Surge để bơi ngược thác nước.

source_en:
A special Gondola that cruises along the most scenic spots in Ragunna City, often called the city sightseeing water bus.
Board the Gondola to relax and enjoy the voyage.
new_translation_vi: Một chiếc Gondola đặc biệt đi dọc theo những điểm tham quan đẹp nhất ở Thành phố Ragunna, thường được gọi là xe buýt nước tham quan thành phố.

source_en: Use Utility: <color=#ffd12f>Flight</color> to leap into the air and start flying. Flight is a Utility specific to Jinzhou (including Mt. Firmament), the Black Shores, and Rinascita regions. Available only while out of combat.
new_translation_vi: Sử dụng Tiện ích: <color=#ffd12f>Flight</color> để nhảy lên không trung và bắt đầu bay. Flight là một Tiện ích dành riêng cho Jinzhou (bao gồm Mt. Firmament), Black Shores và các khu vực Rinascita. Chỉ khả dụng khi không trong trạng thái chiến đấu.

source_en:
When you reach a Leap Spot, using Utility will activate Echo transformation automatically. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and jump.
Aim your camera to the next Leap Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to leap again.
new_translation_vi: Khi bạn đến Leap Spot, việc sử dụng Tiện ích sẽ tự động kích hoạt biến hình Echo. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} nút Tiện ích để biến thành Cuddle Wuddle và nhảy.

source_en:
When you reach a Climbing Spot, the Utility will automatically become Echo transformation. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle for the climbing challenge.
Aim your camera toward the next Climbing Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to climb again.
new_translation_vi: Khi bạn đến Climbing Spot, Tiện ích sẽ tự động trở thành biến hình Echo. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} nút Tiện ích để biến thành Cuddle Wuddle cho thử thách leo trèo.

source_en: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the button while the pointer is in the highlighted section to speed up the progress. The rock will break once the progress bar is full.
new_translation_vi: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} nút khi con trỏ nằm trong phần được đánh dấu để tăng tốc độ tiến trình. Tảng đá sẽ vỡ khi thanh tiến trình đầy.

source_en: When the pointer enters the orange zone, activate Powerful Punch mode. Rapidly {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the left and right buttons to speed up the smashing.
new_translation_vi: Khi con trỏ đi vào vùng màu cam, hãy kích hoạt chế độ Powerful Punch. Nhanh chóng {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} các nút trái và phải để tăng tốc độ đập phá.

source_en:
Nightmare Clouds of ghostly flames. 

Observe the number of flames and absorb Nightmare Clouds <color=#ffd12f>in the correct order</color>. Absorbing them in the wrong order will reset the challenge.
new_translation_vi: Nightmare Cloud của những ngọn lửa ma quái.

source_en:
Nightmare Clouds that keep multiplying.
 
Lottie Lost must use the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the Enhanced Absorption button to <color=#ffd12f>absorb</color> and eliminate all Nightmare Clouds at once.
new_translation_vi: Nightmare Cloud liên tục nhân lên.

source_en:
Lottie Lost draws power from the stories in the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color>, enhancing her ability to absorb Nightmare Clouds.
 
<color=#ffd12f>Hold the Enhanced Absorption button</color> to absorb all Nightmare Clouds within her radius.
 
The Enhanced Absorption state lasts for a limited time and can be refreshed by reading the Finished Book again.
new_translation_vi: Lottie Lost rút sức mạnh từ những câu chuyện trong <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color>, nâng cao khả năng hấp thụ Nightmare Cloud của cô ấy.

source_en:
Guide Lottie Lost to collect the lost pages by following the sensed trail as closely as possible.
Once all the pages are collected, the Unfinished Book will be fully restored.
new_translation_vi: Hướng dẫn Lottie Lost thu thập các trang bị mất bằng cách đi theo dấu vết được cảm nhận càng sát càng tốt.

source_en:
Approach the base and interact with the flickering point to read the <color=#ffd12f>inscription</color>.
Find the painting mentioned in the text and use Levitator to place it on the <color=#ffd12f>matching base.</color>
new_translation_vi: Tiến lại gần bệ và tương tác với điểm nhấp nháy để đọc <color=#ffd12f>dòng chữ khắc</color>.

source_en:
Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.

Clear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all <color=#ffd12f>challenge goals</color> to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.
new_translation_vi: Dreamscape Nodes thu thập các tần số giấc mơ khác nhau, mỗi tần số mang đến những thử thách độc đáo dựa trên giấc mơ và cảm xúc mà chúng chứa đựng.

source_en: Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.
new_translation_vi: Fae Ignis từ Dreamscape sẽ không chết khi quá trình nạp năng lượng bị gián đoạn. Tuy nhiên, khi bị đánh bại, nó sẽ luôn phát nổ và phóng ra các quả cầu lửa với tốc độ nhanh hơn.

source_en: <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacking</color> the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.
new_translation_vi: <color=#ffd12f>Phản đòn</color> các đòn tấn công của Vitreum Dancer có thể làm gãy vũ khí của nó, khiến Vitreum Dancer rơi vào trạng thái Cuồng nộ và trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn nữa.
